opening.argument: The presentation ties promised rewards to both an upfront Bitcoin contribution and continued recruitment. It starts participants at “0.1 BTC” and describes a paid visa used for account activation and qualification, while claiming bonuses will appear after activation. Its referral structure extends an entry-level bonus through ten levels and offers “bonus of 80% to all direct referrals under your account,” while the closing slide solicits referral links, calls Bitcoin multiplying easy, and presents rewards and bonuses as guaranteed. Those features connect payment and recruitment to promised returns. The available video evidence does not establish that anyone paid, received funds, or that the stated amounts were delivered.
